title: Ballot record, version 5 (a rolling poll's ballot, naming its root-clock step): encodings, hashes, admission checks, the step window against the L1 reference, and decode rejections
generator: packages/crypto/scripts/ballot-v5-records-vectors.py, an implementation of the Ballot record (version 5) section and of revoting.md's window check with Python's integers and hashlib, reusing this folder's independent rolling-electorate (version-7 definitions, root clock, chain-order rolling tier trees, rolling scope), tier-tree, ballot-v2, ballot-v3, ballot-v4, membership and revoting generators; every step root is rebuilt here from the listed groups' events; membership proofs by packages/crypto/scripts/ballot-proofs.mjs, run outside the workspace with Semaphore 4.14.3's depth-32 circuit artifacts and snarkjs 0.7.5's fullProve, which checks that each proof's outputs equal the root and nullifier computed here; every pairing verdict is snarkjs's groth16.verify on the signals derived here from the record and the definition. Share hashes are labels, not ciphertext hashes. Decode errors and their offsets are labelled by hand from the strict-decoding rules and the layout's offsets
